annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation creates violation ticket offences for anyone who drives or permits driving of a Level 3, 4 or 5 automated vehicle (section 303.2).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Drive or permit driving of Level 3 automated vehicle
annotation.dates_quote: orders that, effective April 5, 2024, (a) section 35 of the Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2023, S.B.C. 2023, c. 17, is brought into force
annotation.robot_provision_quote: effective April 5, 2024, ... adding the following items as indicated: Section 303.2 (a) Drive or permit driving of Level 3 automated vehicle
